global: Vertical explainer Short about chasing a sunset: off-white canvas with a black horizon line and flat yellow sun discs that turn grey below the horizon (sun-path diagrams with small arrows, red X / green check marks, red dotted verticals); bookended by a saturated PAINTED_PLATE sunset (scribbled red/orange/yellow sky, dark-blue upper sky, two dark stick figures with warm rim light); a dark-grey GLOW plate with a shaded globe and a SUNSET ZONE band; a gridded grey globe with cars and red arrows; twilight gradient plates (blue/magenta glow) with a car; grey MAP_TOUR maps of Scandinavia with a DAY/SUNSET/NIGHT terminator band; presenter at a laptop.
motion: Sun-path sequences: sun copies slide out of the previous sun step by step (continuous slide + yellow-to-grey fill as they cross the horizon), with red X / green check and red dotted guides fading in; 1-frame pops for labels, marks and vehicles; a 5-f shutter/door-open reveal; an 8-f title-and-scene cross-dissolve; the terminator band sweeps slowly across a map (~210 f + ~220 f) while an inset accumulates sun-path copies; red ARCTIC CIRCLE typed along a dashed arc over ~8 f; a 4-f wipe that builds the town scene.
continuity: Yellow = sun above horizon, grey = below; arrows chain each sun to the next; red X = wrong case, green check = right case; the painted sunset plate with the same two figures opens and closes the video; the car keeps one design across twilight plates and maps; the terminator band always carries DAY / SUNSET / NIGHT labels.
